prompt: How many app sessions did the users of each account have? Use every app event in the data (October to December 2025). A user's first app event starts a session, and an event more than 30 minutes after the same user's previous event starts a new one; an event exactly 30 minutes later stays in the same session. Measure each gap as the time between the two moments in event_ts, a UTC instant, never between clock times. Count each session once, for the account of its user. Return two columns, in this order: account_id and sessions. Return one row for each account with app events. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per account with app events

hints: Next, flag the events that start a session and add the flags up for each account.
The gap must come from the same user's previous event, even though the count is per account.

  -- one row per app event
